_readme: Hand-curated routing table: which model + effort each lane of CLAUDE.md gets, and why.
models.json (harvested weekly by tools/model-intel.py) is the FACT layer: ids, context, prices.
This file is the JUDGEMENT layer: it is edited by a human after every catalogue change.
Rule of thumb that motivated the file: a newer model at medium effort often beats an older one
at high; so lanes are re-decided per release, never carried over by habit. Log each decision below.
`/route` should read both files and cite them, never remember a model name.

mecanico.why: search/list/extract: cost floor; no thinking needed

investigador.why: recon returns summaries; breadth over depth

profundo.why: ambiguity and trade-offs; escalate to fable only when opus fails twice

reviewer.why: reviewer >= author; fable reviews fable via tests + external CLI

session-default.why: long autonomous runs and architecture; cache-friendly effort moves on fable
